title: Memory management: who gets the GPU
hook: Before each sampler run, ComfyUI budgets VRAM and evicts what it must. Replay the arithmetic and read your own logs.

verified.claim: The room asked for is total model size × 1.1 + extra_mem, with extra_mem = max(inference memory, memory_required + reserved).
free_memory sorts candidates by most offloaded first, then reference count, then size, smallest first, and stops when enough is free.
With dynamic VRAM on, free_memory does not unload dynamic models for other dynamic models.
The console lines quoted in this lesson come from a run here, and their wording is in model_patcher.py and model_management.py.
An out-of-memory error logs a memory summary and unloads all models.
SD 1.x's U-Net has 860M parameters and SDXL's 2.6B.

unchecked: We did not study dynamic VRAM's on-demand paging in depth and make no timing claims about it. It lives partly in the comfy-aimdo package, which we did not read.
The lab unloads whole models. The real free_memory can unload part of a model and also weighs reference counts.
